Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split layout adoption certificate redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a split layout to showcase the pet preview on one side and official adoption details on the other. (why: Adoption conversion is 78.7% with median 89s / mean 1017s, indicating users pause during certificate setup. Split layout highlights pet identity clearly.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet interaction sound feedback preview: Add a pet sound preview component to the friend picker step so users can sample pet voice audio before selecting. (why: Users reported post-onboarding confusion regarding pet audio and interactions; previewing sound builds instant emotional connection.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet habit profile builder screen: Insert a new pet habit selection screen (new_pet_habits) before adoption certificate where users set active workspace hours for their pet. (why: Addresses support complaints about pets misbehaving or disappearing from the desktop during work hours.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel layout story intro screen redesign: Redesign the story intro screen into a multi-card carousel format explaining the pet app concept. (why: Choose path step has a huge mean time (514s vs median 8s), indicating users pause or idle on intro context.)
4: [sign_in, redesign] Two-column login layout for account persistence: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout explicitly presenting login options alongside account persistence safeguards. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or missing pets after signing back in.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop pet shortcut key hint on home intro: Add a clear keyboard shortcut hint on the home intro screen detailing how to summon or unhide the pet on desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop and 3 emails mentioned confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Account session preservation copy on sign-in: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize automated cloud memory sync to reassure returning users. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) concerns pet data reset or missing pets after re-authenticating.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop controls waiting screen tip: Display a helpful wait tip detailing mouse click and right-click interaction options while waiting. (why: Support tickets show confusion post-onboarding on how to interact with or control the desktop companion.)
8: [home, notification] Notify when pet asset unpacking completes: Enable system notification dispatch when the waiting screen completes background file unpacking. (why: Home waiting step has a high mean time (2336s vs median 201s), showing users leave the desktop app in the background while waiting.)
9: [finish, copy] Pet interaction gesture guide on home intro: Update the home intro body copy with basic mouse gesture instructions for moving and feeding the pet. (why: Finish screen conversion is 76.6% with mean 5815s, and support emails report confusion about controlling and feeding pets.)
